fact: Neverlight Grove is a vast cavern with bioluminescent mushrooms covering every surface, floor to ceiling, and a lake at its heart.
source_quote: It was a vast cavern where bioluminescent mushrooms covered every surface, floor to ceiling, with a lake at its heart.
subject: Neverlight Grove

fact: Rumpadump shouts "We're home! We're home! We're home!" and sprints ahead into the grove.
source_quote: Rumpadump cried "We're home! We're home! We're home!" and sprinted ahead
subject: Rumpadump

fact: Stool runs ahead into the grove alongside Rumpadump.
source_quote: and sprinted ahead with Stool.
subject: Stool

fact: Sarith walks with a quiet, peaceful expression that the party has not seen on him before.
source_quote: Sarith walked with a quiet, peaceful expression that none of the party had seen on him before.
subject: Sarith

fact: Zalthir wraps himself in a shroud of darkness because he does not trust the creatures in the grove.
source_quote: Zalthir, ever cautious, wrapped himself in a shroud of darkness, explaining, "I don't trust any of these things."
subject: Zalthir

fact: Phylo is one of the two sovereigns of Neverlight Grove.
source_quote: The two sovereigns of the grove, Phylo and Basidia
subject: Phylo

fact: Basidia is one of the two sovereigns of Neverlight Grove.
source_quote: The two sovereigns of the grove, Phylo and Basidia
subject: Basidia

fact: Phylo speaks of a coming "day of joy" with eerie enthusiasm.
source_quote: He spoke of a coming "day of joy" with eerie enthusiasm.
subject: Phylo

fact: Phylo praises a figure called the "Great Seeder," claiming she can answer any question.
source_quote: He praised a figure called the "Great Seeder," who could answer any question
subject: Phylo

fact: Phylo uses female pronouns ("she" and "her") to refer to the Great Seeder.
source_quote: and kept calling the entity "she" and "her."
subject: Phylo

fact: Daz notes it is strange for Phylo to use gendered pronouns because myconids have no gender.
source_quote: Daz recalled that this was deeply strange, because myconids have no gender.
subject: Daz

fact: Basidia stares at Phylo in visible discomfort.
source_quote: An insight check revealed that Basidia was staring at Phylo in visible discomfort.
subject: Basidia

fact: Basidia arranges for Phylo to stay behind and leads the tour herself.
source_quote: She arranged for Phylo to stay behind and led the tour herself.
subject: Basidia intervenes

fact: Basidia speaks in hushed, urgent tones while guiding the group through the grove.
source_quote: As she guided the group through the grove, she spoke in hushed, urgent tones.
subject: Basidia

fact: A previous group of "softers" accepted Phylo's hospitality and were taken to the Garden of Welcome.
source_quote: A previous group of "softers" had accepted Phylo's hospitality and been taken to the Garden of Welcome.
subject: Missing softers

fact: Basidia has not seen the previous group of "softers" since they were taken to the Garden of Welcome.
source_quote: She had not seen them since, and Phylo had never mentioned them again.
subject: Basidia

fact: Phylo has never mentioned the previous group of "softers" again.
source_quote: and Phylo had never mentioned them again.
subject: Missing softers

fact: The Garden of Welcome is a location in Neverlight Grove where guests are taken.
source_quote: been taken to the Garden of Welcome.
subject: Garden of Welcome

fact: The party enters Neverlight Grove through a natural tunnel lit by glowing lichen.
source_quote: The party enters the grove through a natural tunnel lit by glowing lichen
subject: Neverlight Grove entrance

fact: The tunnel is the only passage fit for easy travel; others are narrow fissures.
source_quote: The tunnel is the only passage fit for easy travel; the others are narrow fissures.
subject: Neverlight Grove entrance

fact: A mushroom tower is glimpsed through mist beyond a ravine.
source_quote: Beyond a ravine, a mushroom tower is glimpsed through mist.
subject: Neverlight Grove

fact: Gyrgum expresses amazement at the colorful, mushroom-y appearance of the grove.
source_quote: Gyrgum: "Wow, this place looks incredible! So colorful and mushroom-y."
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Gyrgum follows at a distance to observe how the sprouts interact with the sovereigns.
source_quote: Gyrgum follows at a distance to watch how the sprouts interact with Phylo and Basidia.
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Daz jokes that it is good they did not bring pepperoni-mushroom pizzas.
source_quote: Daz jokes that it is a good thing the party has not brought any pepperoni-mushroom pizzas.
subject: Daz

fact: Daz climbs onto high ground to observe the situation.
source_quote: Daz climbs onto high ground to observe.
subject: Daz

fact: Eldeth decides Thorin is "crazy" for following the group.
source_quote: Eldeth decides Thorin is "crazy" for following
subject: Eldeth

fact: Eldeth stands next to Daz instead of following Thorin.
source_quote: and she stands next to Daz instead.
subject: Eldeth

fact: Jimjar walks over with the group.
source_quote: Jimjar and Sarith walk over with the group.
subject: Jimjar

fact: Sarith walks over with the group.
source_quote: Jimjar and Sarith walk over with the group.
subject: Sarith

fact: Phylo welcomes Rumpadump and Stool back to the grove.
source_quote: Phylo: "Welcome, welcome back, Rumpadump and Stool."
subject: Phylo

fact: Stool asks where Zalthir is.
source_quote: Stool asks where Zalthir is
subject: Stool

fact: Stool states that Thorin carried him when he was tired.
source_quote: adds that "Thorin carried me when I was tired."
subject: Stool

fact: Phylo addresses the party as "friendly softers."

subject: Phylo

fact: Phylo offers a tour of the grove but states the Circle of Masters will only be visited the following day.
source_quote: offers a tour of the grove but says the Circle of Masters will only be visited the following day.
subject: Phylo

source_quote: says the Circle of Masters will only be visited the following day.

fact: Sarith advises the group to stay on the sovereign's good side.
source_quote: Sarith advises staying on the sovereign's good side.
subject: Sarith

fact: Gyrgum states he plans to praise whatever Phylo shows them.
source_quote: Gyrgum replies, "Oh, I'm planning to praise the heck out of whatever he shows us."

fact: Phylo describes the Great Seeder as living beyond the garden.
source_quote: Phylo describes the Great Seeder, who lives beyond the garden
subject: Phylo

fact: The Great Seeder is described by Phylo as all-knowing and wise.
source_quote: as all-knowing, wise, and able to answer any question.
subject: Great Seeder

fact: Phylo replies to Basidia, "Yes, Basidia, you are my sovereign and co-equal in all things."
source_quote: Phylo replies, "Yes, Basidia, you are my sovereign and co-equal in all things."
subject: Phylo

fact: Daz rolls an Arcana/Nature check resulting in 12, or 23 with help.

subject: Daz

source_quote: Gyrgum's insight check of 18 catches Basidia looking uncomfortable at Phylo.
subject: Gyrgum

source_quote: Gyrgum and Zalthir trade jokes about "two-in-the-box" management.
